headline: BNP MP Ferdousy Ahmed Misty resigns after PM's directive
summary: The reserved seat MP resigned following a midnight directive from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman after attacks on a healthcare center in Mirpur.
details: Reserved seat Member of Parliament Ferdousy Ahmed Misty has resigned from her position following a direct order from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
The resignation comes after a violent attack on the Radda MCH-FP Center, a mother and child healthcare facility in Mirpur, which was looted and demolished.
The Prime Minister issued the directive on Wednesday night after returning from the UN General Assembly, taking a strict stance against the involvement of party workers in the crime.
Following the incident, the BNP has dissolved the Dhaka North city committee of the party and the Dhaka West city committee of Chhatra Dal, as well as expelling 14 members from various party wings.
The government is facing criticism over law and order issues, including land grabbing and extortion, since the fall of the recent previous administration.
The Radda attack is part of a series of recent crimes, including attacks on a housing project in the ECB area and the studio of content creator Salman Muktadir.
Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that those who break party discipline or engage in unethical activities will not be spared.
The resignation of MP Misty and the organizational shake-up are seen as a clear message that political identity will not be a shield for criminal activity.
caption:
A BNP MP has been forced to resign after her associates were linked to the demolition of a healthcare center.

Reserved seat Member of Parliament Ferdousy Ahmed Misty has resigned from her position following a direct order from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

The resignation comes after a violent attack on the Radda MCH-FP Center, a mother and child healthcare facility in Mirpur, which was looted and demolished.

The Prime Minister issued the directive on Wednesday night after returning from the UN General Assembly, taking a strict stance against the involvement of party workers in the crime.

Following the incident, the BNP has dissolved the Dhaka North city committee of the party and the Dhaka West city committee of Chhatra Dal, as well as expelling 14 members from various party wings.

The government is facing criticism over law and order issues, including land grabbing and extortion, since the fall of the recent previous administration.

The Radda attack is part of a series of recent crimes, including attacks on a housing project in the ECB area and the studio of content creator Salman Muktadir.

Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that those who break party discipline or engage in unethical activities will not be spared.

The resignation of MP Misty and the organizational shake-up are seen as a clear message that political identity will not be a shield for criminal activity.

headline_marked: Banglamotor chaos: [[Expelled Jubo Dal leader detained]] after man injured
headline: Banglamotor chaos: Expelled Jubo Dal leader detained after man injured
summary: Ferdous Ahmed Simon was taken into custody around midnight after an altercation left a man injured and sparked widespread local protests.
details: A 45-year-old man was injured on Thursday night in Dhaka’s Banglamotor area following an altercation with Ferdous Ahmed Simon, an expelled convener of Hatirjheel Thana Jubo Dal.
The incident began around 8:10 pm in a lane on the northern side of Banglamotor, where Simon and his neighbor, Sohan, became involved in an argument.
According to the officer-in-charge of Hatirjheel Police Station, Sohan was struck on the head and sustained injuries. There were also allegations that Simon fired two blank rounds at the scene.
The incident sparked tension, with over 100 local residents gathering outside Simon’s home to chant slogans and accuse him of extortion.
Chaos ensued as a motorcycle was seen on fire beside the Banglamotor-Moghbazar road, and police and SRB personnel were deployed to manage the crowd.
Some locals alleged that law enforcement was protecting Simon instead of detaining him, further escalating the tension in the area.
Police eventually escorted Simon out of his residence and took him into custody around midnight. Legal proceedings are currently underway.
caption:
An expelled Jubo Dal leader was detained after a late-night clash in Banglamotor left a man injured and locals protesting against extortion.

A 45-year-old man was injured on Thursday night in Dhaka’s Banglamotor area following an altercation with Ferdous Ahmed Simon, an expelled convener of Hatirjheel Thana Jubo Dal.

The incident began around 8:10 pm in a lane on the northern side of Banglamotor, where Simon and his neighbor, Sohan, became involved in an argument.

According to the officer-in-charge of Hatirjheel Police Station, Sohan was struck on the head and sustained injuries. There were also allegations that Simon fired two blank rounds at the scene.

The incident sparked tension, with over 100 local residents gathering outside Simon’s home to chant slogans and accuse him of extortion.

Chaos ensued as a motorcycle was seen on fire beside the Banglamotor-Moghbazar road, and police and SRB personnel were deployed to manage the crowd.

Some locals alleged that law enforcement was protecting Simon instead of detaining him, further escalating the tension in the area.

Police eventually escorted Simon out of his residence and took him into custody around midnight. Legal proceedings are currently underway.
